# nomatron_organization_member (Resource)

Nomatron organization member resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nomatron_organization_member" "example" {
  org_name = nomatron_organization.example.name
  username = "rbarnes"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `org_name` (String) Organization name.
- `username` (String) Username to add to the organization.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable composite identifier for the organization membership.
- `joined_at` (String) Timestamp when the user joined the organization.
- `user_id` (String) User ID for the organization member.
